summary:
ExoSky: Constellations from Distant Worlds is an interactive web platform developed for the Imagine an Exoplanet challenge in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Technical Architecture: Built using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+), ExoSky simulates real-time celestial coordinates and custom night sky projections visible from newly discovered exoplanetary systems. It dynamically processes NASA Exoplanet Archive parameters (such as semi-major axes, stellar flux, and orbital periods) to algorithmically generate alien star maps.

Key Features & Impact: Features a responsive cosmic dark-themed UI translating complex astrophysics into accessible celestial storytelling. It bridges raw astronomical data with public engagement, providing an immersive educational tool for space enthusiasts and researchers.
details: Developed using Canva Pro, curated astronomical data references, and structured around interactive public engagement with exoplanets.
